chain_words.nuance: to take a proposal as acceptable
to reach the same opinion after considering it
general sense of being in accord
to give active public support to a position
to defend and promote a cause with strong commitment

explanation: These words all express agreement with someone or something, from simply accepting a proposal to strongly defending a cause.

usage_notes.difference: 'Agree' describes sharing an opinion; 'endorse' means giving active, public support to a position or person.
